data.title: Chunking
data.tagline: Splitting long documents into retrievable passages while preserving needed context.
data.description: A refund rule and its custom-order exception can land in separate chunks. Preserve headings, source positions and useful overlap.
data.learningOutcome: Inspect the resulting chunks. Tables, code and exceptions need appropriate boundaries; tune size and overlap for the documents and queries.

data.boundary: Smaller is not always better. Overlap increases indexed and input content and cannot preserve every dependency.
data.agentPrompt: Show the actual chunks with headings, document versions and source locations. Keep rules with exceptions and preserve table rows and code blocks. Check representative questions for lost context.
